# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Gordon Hughes Estate Agents are delighted to present 60 Jamestown Park to the market, an attractive four bedroomed semi-detached home ideally positioned in the ever-popular Jamestown Park development in Ratoath. Extending to approx. 123sqm, this well-proportioned home offers generous accommodation and excellent potential for modern family living.

## Fakta
- Typ: semi-detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 123 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C2
- Lokalita: 60 Jamestown Park, Ratoath
- Cena: 495 000 €
